title: Honeyed Fermented Peruvian Fish Ceviche Clasico
description: A traditional Peruvian dish with a fermented twist, featuring honey and a tangy, gooey texture. This Ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ceviche is perfect for a hot summer day.
instructions: Combine fish fillets, honey, and chopped cilantro in a large bowl, being careful not to break the fish into pieces.
Let it sit at room temperature for 2 hours, allowing the honey to ferment and break down the fish's proteins.
Stir in chopped red onion and fresh lime juice, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Just before serving, sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro and serve over a bed of mixed greens, garnished with a lime wedge.
Note: be sure to handle the fish safely and cook it to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to avoid foodborne illness.
